description: A design stacked as image over text (a hero and detail circles above a bottom text block). The text block keeps its size and its distance from the bottom edge, lifted to stay inside the safe zone; the fade follows it; the image group scales by k (<= 1) about the canvas centre line to fill what is above, keeping the designer's gap below it and its margin above it (scaled); the background covers the canvas. On the template's own size every rule is the identity, so the native ratio lands on the designer's frame exactly.
